
[[File:酉の市Torinoichi000.jpg|thumb|[[Tori-no-Ichi]]の[[Rake (tool)|Kumade]]]]
'''Ōtori Shrine''' (大鷲神社, also pronounced Ōwashi Shrine) refers to a name for various [[Shinto shrine]]s across Japan. These shrines are part of the [[大鳥信仰|Ōtori faith]], with [[Ōtori taisha]] as their main shrine. Many are related to other shrines with similar names, such as [[Ōtori Shrine (disambiguation)]], [[鷲神社|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)]], and [[鷲宮神社 (曖昧さ回避)|Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)]]. Several are also widely known for hosting [[Tori-no-Ichi]] festivals. There are seven such shrines officially recognized as religious corporations nationwide.

For related terms, see [[Ōtori Shrine (disambiguation)]], [[鷲神社|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)]], [[鷲宮神社 (曖昧さ回避)|Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)]], and [[日鷲神社|Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)]].

* [[大鷲神社 (つくば市)|Ōtori Shrine (Tsukuba)]] - Located in Tedegaki, Tsukuba City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
* [[大鷲神社 (市川市)|Ōtori Shrine (Ichikawa)]] - Located in Takaya, Ichikawa City, Chiba Prefecture.
* [[大鷲神社 (市原市)|Ōtori Shrine (Ichihara)]] - Located in Yanagihara, Ichihara City, Chiba Prefecture.
* [[大鷲神社 (成田市)|Ōtori Shrine (Narita)]] - Located in Kitahatori, Narita City, Chiba Prefecture.
* [[大鷲神社 (栄町)|Ōtori Shrine (Sakae)]] - Located in Anjō, Sakae Town, Inba District, Chiba Prefecture.
* [[大鷲神社 (酒々井町)|Ōtori Shrine (Shisui)]] - Located in Kamiiwahashi, Shisui Town, Inba District, Chiba Prefecture.
* [[大鷲神社 (足立区)|Ōtori Shrine (Adachi)]] - Located in Hanahata, Adachi Ward, Tokyo. Known as the origin of Tori-no-Ichi.
* Ōtori Shrine - Located in Miyamachi, Fuchū City, Tokyo. A subsidiary shrine of [[Ōkunitama Shrine]].
* Ōtori Shrine - Located in Makane-chō, Minami Ward, Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture. Consolidated into the precincts of a [[金刀比羅神社|Konpira Shrine]] (see [[金刀比羅・大鷲神社|Konpira and Ōtori Shrine]]).
